requirements.section: Security and Sync Requirements for Later Target Mapping
requirements.invariant: The adapter consumes only rows already materialized for the Principal/Account workspace, exposes no hidden row or count, and never interprets visibility class, financial access, role or category-administration authority locally; final O-026 download and mutation policy remains outside.

Typed Account/Principal binding and an active local membership row are scope and projection evidence only, not current server authorization; missing or mismatched local scope cannot expose category rows or produce a false complete empty result.

Cached category rows remain useful offline with honest partial or stale quality, while only an independent current-process query-specific completeness observation plus valid local scope may produce ready or authoritative-empty evidence; generic PowerSync sync metadata and restart never manufacture completeness.

requirements.section: Clients, Projects, notes, preferences, and reference data
requirements.invariant: One module-internal PowerSync adapter implements the existing narrow BudgetCategoryReferenceQuerying port, and the public Account-workspace facade binds Account implicitly without exposing a database, SQL, SDK listener, provider object or backend-selection API.

The Account workspace owns exactly one category query and admits every category watch through the same open/closing/closed stream lease: close rejects new watches, cancels and drains the public forwarding task, then invokes the module-internal provider drain that joins its row/completeness observers before either database closes; repeated close retains its existing terminal semantics and no lifecycle API becomes public.

items: Reuse BudgetCategoryDefinitionSnapshot, BudgetCategoryReferenceSnapshot, BudgetCategoryReferenceQuerying and BudgetCategoryReferenceFailure without a second category, eligibility, order, readiness or visible-count model.
The provider maps every materialized row into the exact verified domain initializer and emits no snapshot if any row or aggregate invariant is malformed.

items: Bind one adapter to exact Principal and Account. Reject a different Account before database observation and require active same-Principal local membership as a scope sentinel before emitting materialized categories.

Observe a sentinel-preserving left join so valid active membership plus zero categories remains distinguishable from missing scope. Do not select or interpret visibility_class, financial_access or role beyond the active membership sentinel.

Map exact identity, name, kind, lifecycle, system/exclusion booleans, UInt32 presentation order and UInt64 revision; reject null, overflow, unknown enum, invalid boolean, duplicate identity/name/order and cross-Account rows atomically.

Combine database and explicit completeness observations reactively. Default completeness is false; generic hasSynced/lastSyncedAt can affect partial-versus-stale quality only and can never prove complete or authoritative empty.

Derive deterministic Account-bound query fingerprint and content-bound LocalDataVersion from scope state, completeness, quality and every canonical emitted field; visible count equals emitted local rows only.

Consumer cancellation stops both underlying observations. Ordinary runtime close cancels/drains category watches with the existing stream lease before database close, preserves encrypted state, and restart begins incomplete until fresh completeness evidence arrives.

verification.expected: A real encrypted local database with active exact membership emits every already-materialized ordinary- and restricted-class category in canonical order with exact fields, emitted-row visible count, Account-bound fingerprint and content-bound version, without a local visibility decision.

Independent database and completeness changes emit reactive partial/stale/ready states; close/reopen preserves encrypted category rows but resets completeness until fresh current-process evidence, and only active scope plus explicit true completeness may emit ready or authoritative empty.

Cross-Account calls refuse before observation; missing/inactive/cross-Principal membership emits no false complete snapshot; malformed/cross-Account/duplicate/overflow/unknown rows and raw database failure yield no partial snapshot and only bounded diagnostics.
Consumer cancellation terminates database and completeness observations, stale events cannot emit afterward, and restart or generic PowerSync status alone never promotes completeness.

Normal bootstrap constructs exactly one category query; runtime watch uses the existing tracked stream lease, close cancels and drains it before both database closes, a concurrent new/post-close watch refuses, and ordinary close/reopen preserves local rows without claiming session ending.

verification.owner: Swift compile-time facade assertions and scripts/check-target-environment.mjs exact source/build-graph checks
verification.expected: Compile-time facade assertions plus exact checks on the frozen environment-control script prove the public runtime exposes only zero-argument watchBudgetCategories(), while BudgetCategoryReferencePowerSyncQuery and every raw Account rebinding, database, SQL, completeness source, membership predicate, visibility policy, provider object and category mutation remain non-public; MCP gains no surface. This test claims no compiler symbol-graph tooling.

The exact synchronized implementation checkpoint passes conversion controls, focused and complete nonparallel target tests, existing local Supabase schema/RLS regressions, compiler boundaries, both staging builds and clean generated artifacts without hosted or production access.

On one live watch, active scope plus explicit completeness first emits nonempty ready evidence; changing membership to inactive/revoked and then deleting it clears all previously emitted rows immediately as empty partial, forces isCompleteForQuery false while completeness remains true, and stale completeness events never re-promote ready or authoritative-empty evidence.

A reciprocal matrix independently varies Account/category ID, name, all three kinds, both lifecycles, both system/exclusion booleans, presentation order, revision, canonical row membership, scope sentinel, completeness and quality. Literal outputs remain column-owned; LocalDataVersion changes for each content/readiness axis but not SQL input order alone; QueryFingerprint stays stable across content/readiness for one Account and changes across Accounts.
